system.description: Venom from snakes and sea creatures: 1 wound per degree. Any injury or wound from it takes away speech and may cause –1D to Endurance (Formidable 12 Endurance test).
system.effects:
Virulence 5; Toxicity 2; Frequency 1/round; Diagnosis Challenging (9).

Venom from snakes and sea creatures: 1 wound per degree. Any injury or wound from it takes away speech and may cause –1D to Endurance (Formidable 12 Endurance test).
system.recovery: Injuries and wounds heal normally; the Endurance penalty is permanent unless a Destiny Point is burned (then 2d6 days).
